$comment: Hand ledger: third-party components inside shipped files that no machine reading can list.
keys: what the entries were read from; generate.mjs warns when the shipped file differs.
bundles: prebuilt bundles inside mermaid.min.js whose own source map is not shipped, with what is inside them.
go: license names (and the chosen one) of the Go modules that the build info of d2.wasm lists.
stdlib: Go itself (its standard library and runtime) in d2.wasm; {go} in text is the Go version read from d2.wasm.
components: name, version, license, chosen (for an OR expression), repository, container, source (copyleft only),
copyright (lines from the shipped file when the license text has none), note (text put before the license text),
text (npm:<name>@<version>, go:<module>@<version>, url:<URL>, or a file under third-party-licenses/), key, found.
found says how the entry was checked; unverified marks what could not be checked.
